decisions.briefing: NASDAQ -0.3% and S&P 500 -0.4% today — a neutral, slightly soft session with no clear risk-on signal. Cash ($589) is only marginally above the deploy threshold, and per prior lessons we hold rather than force a buy into a flat/down tape; existing positions stay untouched and stop-loss/profit-target rules continue running automatically.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted lower today with the NASDAQ down 0.3% and the S&P 500 down 0.4%, a mild pullback rather than a decisive move in either direction. Trading volumes and sector leadership did not show the kind of broad participation that typically signals a strong directional trend. With no confirming catalyst, the market essentially took a pause after recent moves.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市略為走軟，納指下跌0.3%，標普500下跌0.4%，屬於溫和回調而非明確的方向性走勢。成交量及板塊表現未見廣泛參與的跡象，未能確認強烈的趨勢訊號。在缺乏明確催化劑下，市場基本上是在近期波動後稍作喘息。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A 'risk-off' day is when the market lacks a clear bullish catalyst, so cautious investors hold back from adding new positions even if cash is available. It's not about predicting a crash — it's about not chasing mediocre setups just to stay 'fully invested,' since patience preserves capital for higher-conviction opportunities.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險規避」（Risk-Off）指市場缺乏明確的利好催化劑，審慎的投資者即使手頭有現金，也會暫緩加倉。這並非預測市場會下跌，而是不want因為想「全數投入資金」而追逐平庸的入市機會，保持耐性才能把資金留給更高把握的機會。
